text: 深成指跌超1%，沪指跌0.44%，创业板指跌0.91%，贵金属、房地产、白酒、旅游等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近3500只。
text_en: The Shenzhen Component Index fell more than 1%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.44%, and the ChiNext Index fell 0.91%. Precious metals, real estate, baijiu, tourism and other sectors led the declines, with nearly 3,500 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
